desc: Ideation complete: Analyzed the problem and identified the need for an efficient approach beyond O(n^2).
Precompute `L[i]` (max subarray sum in `nums[0..i]`) and `R[i]` (max subarray sum in `nums[i..n-1]`).
Precompute `max_ending_at[i]` (max subarray sum ending at `i`) and `max_starting_at[i]` (max subarray sum starting at `i`).
Group indices by value to quickly access positions of each unique element.
For each unique element `x`, calculate the max subarray sum of the array with `x` removed by checking segments between its occurrences.
Return the maximum of the original max subarray sum and all computed removal sums.
